description: Differences from homelab-images: no PR is opened until its checkbox is ticked in the dependency dashboard (dependencyDashboardApproval), because merging to main publishes manifests that flux applies to the cluster. Commits read 'bump <name> to <version>' to match this repo's history, rather than using semantic commits.
gitIgnoredAuthors: the refresh-assets workflow pushes regenerated assets to renovate branches, and renovate must not treat those commits as someone editing the branch (which stops it from rebasing).
dependencyDashboardHeader:
This issue lists Renovate updates and detected dependencies. Read the [Dependency Dashboard](https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/dashboard/) docs to learn more.

Entries under **Detected dependencies** marked `(pinned: ...)` are deliberately held back for this environment and are never updated.

customManagers.description: Tracked: a '# renovate:' comment on the line above a version (datasource + depName) or above a commit sha (git-refs + branch).
Tracked: helm.pull({ repo, chart, version }) in a template's asset.ts.
Tracked: helm.pull({ chart: 'oci://...', version }) in a template's asset.ts.
Tracked: container image references ('[registry/]path/name:tag') in templates.
Pinned: a '# renovate-pinned:' comment above a version. The version is read from the line below, never from the comment. Listed in the dashboard's detected dependencies, never updated.

packageRules.description: VERSIONS: assets/ is generated output (vendored jsonnet, go modules, workflows, etc.) and is never tracked.
GROUPING: all workflow action updates arrive as one PR.
VERSIONS: node is tracked via '# renovate:' annotations everywhere, so the workflows and devcontainer agree on one source. Turn off the built-in actions tracking of it.
VERSIONS: package.json 'engines' is a compatibility floor, not a pin.
GROUPING / VERSIONS / PR NOTE: the node version in the devcontainer and workflows moves together, and only even (LTS) majors are used.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ When changing the node major, also change the `@types/node` major in `package.json` to match.

packageRules.description: VERSIONS: linuxserver appends a '-lsNNN' build suffix that changes on every rebuild.
VERSIONS: llama.cpp releases are monotonically increasing build numbers.
PINNED: shown in the dashboard, never updated. (The datasource above only exists so the entry isn't skipped.)
PR NOTE: asset.ts bumps are regenerated by the refresh-assets workflow.
prBodyNotes: ℹ️ The `refresh-assets` workflow regenerates `assets/` on this branch. Check that it (and its manifest generation check) passes before merging.

packageRules.description: PR NOTE: envoy-gateway supports a specific range of gateway-api releases.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ `envoy-gateway` supports a specific gateway-api release range. Bump and check them together.

packageRules.description: VERSIONS: the @types/node major follows the node major in the devcontainer and workflows, so it only changes together with node (by hand, in package.json). Minor and patch updates are fine.
